title: Configure the relay connection
responsibility: Create the remote-host runtime only when its origin and object binding are usable.

inputs.name: hubRemote.env
inputs.description: HubEnv is the hub's environment record; the function reads its optional HARNESS_RELAY_ORIGIN, HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT and REMOTE_HOSTS (the Durable Object namespace binding). A missing or unusable origin or binding makes the function return null: the origin must be https, or http on localhost or 127.0.0.1 unless HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT is 'production', with no credentials, path, query or fragment, and the binding must expose idFromName and get functions.

outputs.name: hubRemote
outputs.description: The value is null unless both a usable origin and a usable REMOTE_HOSTS binding are present. Otherwise it is an object whose origin is the normalized URL origin (scheme, host and port, no path) and whose relay is a RelayManageAdapter built on the binding; that class instance cannot be written as JSON, so the examples show only null.
